product: Salesforce connector mTLS authentication is now generally available
tagline: Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication for the Salesforce connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available.
what_it_does: Mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication for the Salesforce connector in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available. With mTLS, Databricks and Salesforce exchange and verify client certificates to establish two way trust, combined with the OAuth client credentials flow. Choose it for API only users or when your organization requires mTLS.
why_it_matters: important For security purposes, only authenticate if you clicked an OAuth 2.0 link in the Databricks UI.
